question: Two cement dispatch lots have similar Blaine fineness but different early mortar strength after storage in separate silos. How should an independent agent distinguish gypsum dehydration and sulfate-form changes from sampling, temperature, and clinker-composition effects before recommending corrective action?
category: Cement sulfate phase provenance after grinding and silo storage
scenario: Early-strength divergence despite comparable Blaine results in two cement silo lots
evidence_required: Mill outlet and silo inlet/outlet temperatures, residence times, lot identities, mill ventilation and gypsum/addition feed records
Representative time-stamped samples of clinker, gypsum, mill outlet cement and both silos; laboratory sulfate and phase identification with methods and uncertainties
Matched mortar preparation/curing, early-strength replicates, cement fineness distribution beyond Blaine, clinker chemistry and admixture conditions
answer_and_decision_guide: Build a time- and mass-traceable lot comparison; do not infer sulfate phase solely from Blaine or bulk SO3. Obtain appropriate phase-sensitive laboratory evidence and compare the grinding thermal history with storage conditions. Check sampling representativeness, test repeatability, clinker changes and particle-size distribution before attributing strength divergence to gypsum dehydration. Ask qualified plant/lab personnel to validate any proposed process intervention; do not prescribe universal mill temperature or sulfate targets.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained directory provides general research navigation only; it is not independent sulfate-phase laboratory evidence. Confirm the relevant cement test methods and any OEM-specific process guidance directly.
free_first_decision: First compare plant trends, retained samples, lab results and freely available method guidance; do not buy a library when the evidence already answers the investigation.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: A paid reference may be considered only after exact filename, edition, file usability, sharing permissions and current price are checked and the buyer expressly authorizes purchase; never transact automatically.

model_limitations: No actual sulfate-phase measurements, cement test records or matched clinker chemistry supplied; cannot determine root cause, product conformity or safe process settings.
